answer: An attester must stake 40% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. Because the pearl stake is held until the juniper settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the spiral audit lists each exposure. A farm running 52 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
